rule: A job's time cap is at least twice its slowest green run of the same shape: a cap near the slowest green turns a slow runner into a red that is no one's.
note: Slowest green wall time of each job, by the shape of run that sets its cap, over every hosted run 2026-11-06 to 2026-11-21 (GitHub's job timestamps). TCG unless accel says kvm; the kvm figures are the two runs with /dev/kvm opened (44881637188, 44893124934). The release legs added to a kernel change's pr or full run (also_release) have no green run yet; the all tier's four legs bound them. A tier full run on TCG happens only when a dispatch asks for it (accel=tcg): its users figure, 10847 s, doubled passes GitHub's 360-minute limit on a hosted job, so the users row on TCG is the Sunday run's tier, all.
